name: server-survival
description: Dev tooling for Server Survival. The game itself has NO build step at serve time — it is served raw from this repo by GitHub Pages, including the committed vendor/ assets. Everything here is optional and for contributors only (lint, tests, CSS build, CI).

scripts.check:css: npm run build:css && git diff --exit-code -- vendor/tailwind/tailwind.css
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test
